# NNNN — Decision title

- Status: Proposed
- Scope: Business / Architecture / Infrastructure
- Owner:
- Acceptance evidence:
- Supersedes / superseded by:

## Context

What specific problem requires a decision? Link the source requirement and relevant constraints.
Separate observed evidence from assumptions. Identify the stable baseline affected, if any.

## Decision

State the chosen behavior or trade-off precisely. Until acceptance is recorded, this is a proposal,
not authority to implement it. Mark any requested architecture exception explicitly.

## Alternatives

List meaningful alternatives, including keeping the current behavior when applicable. Explain why
the selected option fits the requirement; do not invent alternatives merely to fill the template.

## Consequences

Describe benefits, costs, operational/data/security impact and compatibility. Include failure
semantics and recovery constraints where relevant. State what remains out of scope.

## Verification and adoption

Link the specification/tests or other evidence that will check the decision. Record migration or
rollout steps only when needed and separately authorized. After implementation, record observed
results rather than predicting a successful deployment.
